excerpt.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
excerpt.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.
